briefing: 今日导读：Snap推出Specs Intelligence AI助手，增强用户任务管理能力。OpenSpec简化AI项目开发，而AI数据中心废弃物问题引关注。此外，Apple计划重返服务器市场，OpenAI不断扩展广告能力。
highlights: 今日看点：Snap的Specs Intelligence AI助手和OpenSpec框架的推出，显示出AI助力日常与行业应用的趋势正在加强。同时，AI产业带来的环境问题开始被注意，特别是数据中心的电子废弃物。Apple进军服务器市场与AI技术的结合，也意味着科技巨头们正重新审视其在AI时代的核心业务战略。

events.title: Snap 推出 Specs Intelligence AI 助手
events.summary: Snap 正在推出名为「Specs Intelligence」的新 AI 助手，能够连接其他数字账户，帮助处理工作任务和旅行信息。与 Meta 的 Muse 和 Gemini 的 Spark 相似，Specs Intelligence 被定位为一种「自我预见的 AI 服务」，帮助用户管理需要关注的事务，并朝向长期目标努力。此外，Specs Intelligence 也已在 iOS 和 Mac 平台上推出。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
Snap推出了AI助手Specs Intelligence，让用户可以通过连接数字账户来管理日常事务。

### 为什么令人兴奋
此助手可以连接不同平台，为用户提供统一的AI管理体验，增强个人管理效率。

### 产品机会
开发能够无缝整合个人账户和公共信息源的多功能管理工具，提升用户在旅行及工作管理方面的体验。

### 格局影响
Snap此举可能削弱像Meta和Google在个人助理领域的主导地位，拉近与助手领域领导者的距离。

### 冷静判断
目前该助手已经在iOS和Mac上推出，表明技术已经成熟，但需观察其用户接受度。

### 趋势坐标
此事件与近期AI助手多领域应用的扩展趋势相符，例如AI对智能家居的整合应用。

articles.title: Snap is launching a new Specs AI tool, and it’s coming to iOS and Mac
articles.text: Snap is introducing "Specs Intelligence," a new AI assistant that can connect other digital accounts to help you with things like work tasks and keeping track of travel information. It seems similar to AI assistants like Meta's Muse and Gemini's Spark, though Snap is pitching Specs Intelligence as an "anticipatory AI service" that "helps you manage what needs attention today, so you can make progress toward your longer-term goals." Like with other AI assistants, you can also chat with it. Specs Intelligence is being launched alongside Specs, Snap's first consumer pair of augmented reality glasses. But it's also available on iOS today in pre … Read the full story at The Verge.

events.title: AI 数据中心废弃物问题加剧
events.summary: 一项新报告警告称，AI 产业产生的电子废弃物被严重低估。到 2050 年，电子废弃物的数量可能达到 2300 万个集装箱，足以环绕地球六圈。该报告的作者考虑了支持数据中心服务器所需的所有基础设施，从而提供了更清晰的 AI 留下的垃圾图景。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
AI数据中心的电子废弃物问题被严重低估，未来可能带来环境压力。

### 为什么令人兴奋
该报告将AI行业的电子垃圾问题透明化，揭示其不可忽视的环境影响。

### 产品机会
推动开发绿色计算技术和环保的数据中心设计，降低电子废弃物生成量。

### 格局影响
这将影响到整个AI行业巨头，需要改革现有基础设施以减少废物生成。

### 冷静判断
尽管问题被提出，但行业变化需要协作和政策引导，短期内难有实质改变。

### 趋势坐标
该问题增强了近年来对可持续科技发展的关注，与全球范围内的绿色能源倡议相呼应。

articles.title: The AI data center e-waste problem is huge — and getting bigger
articles.text: E-waste from the AI boom has been vastly underestimated, a new report warns. By 2050, it could become enough trash to fill 23 million shipping containers - roughly enough 40-foot containers to circle the world six times if lined up in a row. It's a significantly higher estimate of AI's e-waste than previous studies have found because the authors of the new report factor in all the infrastructure needed to support servers in data centers. The broader scope provides a clearer picture of junk AI leaves behind, according to the nonprofit Basel Action Network (BAN) , which published the paper today. "AI may feel weightless, but every model dep … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.text: According to The Information , Apple is planning to get back into the server game and might just pair up with Nvidia to make it happen. But the growing demand for compute power as the AI industry continues to expand has apparently led the company to believe there is an opening for its powerful but efficient ARM-based M processors. articles.text: Google is inviting third-party agents, including Claude and Open Claw, into Google Home. | Photo by Jennifer Pattison Tuohy / The Verge Google is opening up its smart home to AI agents, letting tools like Claude and Open Claw access and control your connected devices and analyze your home's data using the standardized Model Context Protocol .
